articles.title: AI Cloud Startup Verda Raises $189 Million in Funding Round
articles.summary: Cloud startup Verda has raised $189 million in fresh financing, underscoring continued investor appetite for the infrastructure powering the artificial intelligence boom.
articles.author: Paula Doenecke

articles.title: Ligent Technologies to Debut After $727 Million in Hong Kong IPO
articles.summary: AI computing networks maker Ligent Technologies Inc. is set to debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on Tuesday after raising HK$5.7 billion ($727 million) in a initial public offering, adding to this year’s stampede of companies capitalizing on the global artificial intelligence buildout.
articles.author: Sangmi Cha

articles.title: Trump-Xi Summit Puts Global AI Race in Focus
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what to expect from the Trump-Xi summit later this week, with AI's role anticipated to be a major part of the agenda for those upcoming talks. Plus, Bloomberg reports Paramount reached a settlement with California and other states suing to block its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. And, as data shows more disruption to US data centers, we get to the political debate with Democratic US Representative Suhas Subramanyam from Virginia. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Paramount settles lawsuit blocking $110 billion Warner Bros. merger
articles.summary: Paramount has reached a settlement with California and the 11 other states that sued to block its planned $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. articles.title: Nvidia Buying an Additional $1.5 Billion in SB Energy Shares Ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp. is buying an additional $1.5 billion in shares of SB Energy Inc., a data center provider backed by SoftBank Group Corp., ahead of that company’s US initial public offering.
articles.author: Nick Turner

articles.title: How AI Could Spark the Next Copper Boom
articles.summary: AI data centers and power grid upgrades are quietly reshaping global copper demand. Morgan Stanley’s Amy Gower breaks down why data centers already punch above their weight, and why US tariff decisions could move copper next. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic is reportedly delaying its IPO from October to November 2026 to present strong Q3 results. Investors expect a roughly $2 trillion valuation, but rising infrastructure costs, including $1.25 billion a month for its SpaceX deal alone, and unresolved security risks complicate the listing. articles.title: Investing for the AI Boom: Masters in Business with Glen Kacher
articles.summary: Barry speaks with Glen Kacher, Managing Director and CIO of Light Street Capital. They discuss his tenure at Integral Capital Partners, as well as his start at Tiger Management under founder Julian Robertson. They discuss being a hedge fund surrounded by venture capital in Silicon Valley, as well as learning to embrace the speed of tech. They also discuss the polarization of data centers and what AI will look like five years from now. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Nvidia-Backed Data Center Firm Nscale Files Publicly for IPO
articles.summary: Nscale, a developer of artificial intelligence data centers that counts Nvidia Corp. and Microsoft Corp. among its partners, filed for an initial public offering in New York to fund the equipment satisfying AI’s insatiable demand for computing power.
